objective: Add canonical bounded multi-relationship D1 reads for acquisition cost, premium, commission, and renewal facts so aggregate acquisition analytics can avoid relationship-at-a-time economic N+1 reads.
rules: The caller supplies a finite relationship ID set.
Every requested relationship ID is validated before database access.
Duplicate requested relationship IDs are removed while preserving first-request order.
Empty requested relationship sets return empty arrays without issuing a D1 query.
Each fact domain uses one bounded IN query for the requested relationships.
Existing canonical economic row hydrators remain the only hydration path.
Batch results are deterministically ordered by relationship ID, occurred timestamp, and fact identity.
Existing singular relationship reads remain available and unchanged.
No economic write semantics are changed.
next: Compose bounded presentation and economics batch reads into the D1-backed aggregate acquisition analytics application.
